title: cognition-gate-intention-extraction
intention: Build the intention_fidelity sieve — a build_inspector sieve that measures whether a component's charter faithfully translates its originating ticket's intention, not just whether the charter file exists. Keyword-overlap comparison between charter falsifier and ticket falsifier, bidirectional: under-coverage (over-hedging) and scope-creep (over-claiming) both fire.
why: charter_on_disk checks existence, not fidelity. A charter that copies the ticket's intention field but rewrites the falsifier passes the structural check while failing the cognitive one. The anti-hallucination principle (don't over-claim AND don't over-hedge) is already proven in skill_block's door; this sieve applies it to the charter-to-ticket relationship.
traces_to: Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass.
Design: cocoon-settle-stages-around-cc — cheaper stages pre-process around CC.
Review: review-cc-patterns-for-cognition-gates — designed from the anti-hallucination bidirectional principle.

proves_green.proof_gate: tester sealed green, non-hollow tooth, netns

falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: (1) no sieve named intention_fidelity registered in SIEVES; (2) a component whose charter falsifier rewrites the ticket's falsifier without coverage passes the sieve (hollow green); (3) a component whose charter faithfully translates its ticket fails the sieve (false positive). DONE when the sieve is registered, proved non-hollow, and sealed by the tester.

how: A new row-level sieve intention_fidelity(row, comp_dir) in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py, registered in SIEVES (D1, D4). It pairs the component's charter falsifier with the falsifier of every ticket whose owning_intention names that charter, scores keyword coverage and invented scope (D2), and reds a component whose best pair falls past thresholds frozen from the 2026-11-05 census (D3; open-9570fbb8e2af, Akien's approval of CC's census proposal, replaced the 80%/20% first cut). Proof: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_intention_fidelity.py (D5).

decisions.text: Re-pointed 2026-10-18 from 'CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/review-cc-patterns-for-cognition-gates.md': cross() reaches only a charter file (intention+why.json or _charter+why.json), and the code it builds is a sieve in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py, so the crossing journals at that component. The intention prose stays at CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/review-cc-patterns-for-cognition-gates.md. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'

D1: WHERE. One function intention_fidelity(row: dict, comp_dir: Path) -> list[dict] in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py, placed after charter_on_disk, plus one helper _fidelity_keywords(value) -> set[str] beside it and the module constants FIDELITY_STOPWORDS, FIDELITY_COVERAGE_FLOOR and FIDELITY_INVENTED_CEILING. Nothing else in the inspector changes except the SIEVES entry (D4).

D2: THE MEASURE. _fidelity_keywords(value): text = value if str else json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True); return {w for w in re.findall(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_]{3,}', text.lower()) if w not in FIDELITY_STOPWORDS}. FIDELITY_STOPWORDS is the frozenset of: the and that this with from into when what which while where every each only than then they them their there these those have has had not are was were been being will would should could must does done for but any all its it's onto over under once also just more most such same other some none nor own very can our out who whom why how both. THE PAIRS: charter = comp_dir / 'intention+why.json'; if it is absent or unparseable return [] (charter_on_disk owns absence). repo = the first ancestor A of comp_dir.resolve() for which (A.parent / 'CairnCommons' / 'tickets') is a directory; none found -> return []. key = charter.resolve().relative_to(repo) as a posix string (e.g. 'cairn/tools/data_recorder/intention+why.json'). Read every ticket with cairn.tools.base.ticket_file plans(repo.parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets') and read_ticket, skipping any that raises; keep those whose str(owning_intention).strip() == key. For each kept ticket: C = _fidelity_keywords(charter['falsifier']), T = _fidelity_keywords(ticket['falsifier']); skip the pair if C or T is empty. coverage = len(T & C) / len(T); invented = len(C - T) / len(C). No pairs -> return []. best_coverage = max coverage; best_invented = min invented.

D3: THE THRESHOLDS, FROZEN FROM THE CENSUS (open-9570fbb8e2af, answered 2026-09-24: Akien approved CC's proposal 'set the thresholds from the census, with the census cited as the source (Law 3)'). FIDELITY_COVERAGE_FLOOR = 0.07 and FIDELITY_INVENTED_CEILING = 0.95, each with a comment citing the census: 2026-11-05, the D2 measure over the live corpus, 419 charter/ticket pairs across 49 components; 0.07 is the 10th percentile of per-component best_coverage, 0.95 the 90th percentile of per-component best_invented. Constants, never recomputed at run time (a live percentile would red a fixed fraction forever). Findings: best_coverage < FLOOR -> _finding('intention_fidelity', row['component'], "the charter's falsifier covers its tickets' falsifiers", expected=FIDELITY_COVERAGE_FLOOR, actual=round(best_coverage, 3), compare='>=', charter=key, pairs=n, best_ticket=<id of the best-coverage ticket>, reason='over-hedging'); best_invented > CEILING -> _finding('intention_fidelity', row['component'], "the charter's falsifier claims no scope its tickets lack", expected=FIDELITY_INVENTED_CEILING, actual=round(best_invented, 3), compare='<=', charter=key, pairs=n, reason='over-claiming'). Both can fire. Measured blast radius at cast: data_recorder, sleep_cycle, corrosion, exemptions, survey, orient, skill_block and constrain red at their own next crossings; build_inspector (0.48 / 0.81) stays green.
D4: REGISTER. Add "intention_fidelity": intention_fidelity, to the SIEVES dict directly after "charter_on_disk": charter_on_disk,.

D5: THE PROOF. Create cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_intention_fidelity.py in the check()/FAILURES/TEETH/main shape of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, _REPO = parents[4], every import of the inspector inside its tooth. PROVES = {'5dbc03e007c5': {'1': 'test_the_sieve_is_registered', '2': 'test_a_rewritten_falsifier_reds', '3': 'test_a_faithful_falsifier_passes'}}. A fixture world per tooth under cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir('testing-5dbc03e007c5-'): W/cairn/cairn/machines/fixture_comp/intention+why.json and W/CairnCommons/tickets/aaaaaaaaaaaa-fixture.json (a plan file carrying id, title, owning_intention 'cairn/machines/fixture_comp/intention+why.json' and falsifier, plus its aaaaaaaaaaaa-fixture.state.json carrying workflow_and_state, so read_ticket reads it), row = {'component': 'fixture_comp', 'dir': 'machines/fixture_comp', 'charter_on_disk': True}, comp_dir = W/cairn/cairn/machines/fixture_comp. Ticket falsifier fixture: 'RED when the sieve intention_fidelity misses a rewritten charter falsifier; GREEN when coverage of ticket keywords holds above the floor'. (1) 'intention_fidelity' in SIEVES and SIEVES['intention_fidelity'] is intention_fidelity. (2) charter falsifier 'Bananas ripen yellow quickly overnight' -> the sieve returns findings naming over-hedging AND over-claiming, while charter_on_disk(row, comp_dir) returns [] (the hollow green the ticket names). (3) charter falsifier equal to the ticket's -> []. Run: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_intention_fidelity.py', twice. Hollow: bin/cairn test --hollow 5dbc03e007c5 --proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_intention_fidelity.py.
